diagnostics.message: aws_eks_node_group.this provision instances asynchronously and can launch/join the cluster before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this is applied. The node role (aws_iam_role.this) must have its policies attached first (AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy, AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy, AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly), otherwise nodes join without permissions and EKS cannot properly manage EC2 instances and ENIs.
aws_eks_node_group.this should also wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.additional so that any user-specified policies on the node role are attached before instances launch and join the cluster.

aws_eks_fargate_profile.this uses pod_execution_role_arn (aws_iam_role.this) whose policies (aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this) must be attached before pods execute; the fargate profile should wait for the policy attachment to be applied.

aws_eks_fargate_profile.this should also depend on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.additional so additional policies on the pod execution role are attached before the profile becomes ACTIVE and pods are scheduled.

aws_autoscaling_group.this launches EC2 instances whose role needs aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this (e.g. AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy) attached before instance launch; the graph shows no reference to the launch template or the policy attachment, so no ordering is guaranteed.
aws_autoscaling_group.this should also wait for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.additional so additional policies on the node role are attached before instances are launched by the autoscaling group.
